threads.body:
The empty-completion sentinel is documented as applying to a user message, but `message_text` includes system, assistant, and tool messages too. Consequently, a marker quoted in non-user conversation history suppresses every streamed response (including tool calls). Restrict sentinel detection to messages whose role is `user`.

This issue also appears on line 569 of the same file.

replies.body: Fixed in 0f6b85a: both markers are read from the last user message only.
